newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian clothing firm says profits up.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian clothing firm says profits up.

text.p: Kabo /Nasr Clothing and Textiles said on Wednesday its after-tax profits rose to 22.5 million pounds in the financial year 1995/6. They were 16.08 million pounds in the previous year.
The board is recommending an annual dividend of 4.00 pounds for each of the 3.062 million shares, it added.
For the previous year the company gave a dividend of 2.90 pounds, plus a free share with a nominal value of 1.00 pound for each of the 1.521 million shares then issued.
The shares last traded on the Egyptian stock exchange at 65.50 pounds on September 17.
The company said production in 1995/6, which ended on June 30, was worth 162.1 million pounds, 16.8 percent up a target of 138.8 million. Turnover in 1994/5 was 154.25 million pounds.
It said pre-tax profits for distribution were 29.6 million. In the previous year they were 23.5 million.
